The resulting contract: NEW dev/repair sessions declare the operator unattended mode once before the first turn; resumed sessions are never switched and record the mode the host reports; nothing is changed in reaction to prompts, timeouts or failures; read-only sessions and probes never set a mode. FINAL CONFIRMATION, verbatim, 2026-09-18: "无头的这种没有办法让用户选择的可yolo，其余的先不吧" — headless sessions with no path to a user decision may run yolo (the NEW dev/repair pre-turn declaration); nothing else: resumed sessions are never switched and record the mode the host reports, read-only sessions and probes never set a mode.

native_verification.read_only_boundary: Read-only roles' native events contain only Read/Glob/Grep calls; side-effect tools appear exclusively in the development job. The dev session's tool-policy.json records permission_mode from the host's own settings readback, not from a constant.
native_verification.raw_evidence_gate: Since fa44747 admission re-verifies this run through the harness evidence chain itself: open_run re-checks the runtime-identity binding and the spec/requirement digests, every worker receipt goes through Store.verify_evidence (artifact integrity, comparison inputs, job receipts, stream proofs, native source files), and the terminal artifact is read back. A report without its raw jobs and artifacts can no longer carry the unit (control ADM-E16).
native_verification.provider_choice: The contract requires carrying the fixed native transport and names no host ("承载固定的原生传输；不同时更换宿主协议").
